description: Na₃WN₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.63 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.85 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.89 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to four N atoms to form distorted NaN₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four WN₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.57 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.61 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.48-2.64 Å. There are two inequivalent W sites. In the first W site, W is bonded to four N atoms to form WN₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaN₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent WN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of W-N bond distances ranging from 1.82-1.94 Å. In the second W site, W is bonded to four N atoms to form WN₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaN₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent WN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of W-N bond distances ranging from 1.83-1.95 Å. There are six inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two W atoms. In the second N site, N is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two W atoms. In the third N site, N is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one W atom. In the fourth N site, N is bonded to five Na and one W atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NNa₅W octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-56°. In the fifth N site, N is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one W atom.
